confirmation: additional blinded experiment or context; pilot alone does not establish broad transfer
interventions: select a shared target panel from qualified single-effect coverage and biological effect diversity
time_and_reagent_policy: same declared intervention conditions across contexts; record guide assignment and efficacy
replication: prospective precision/power calculation; independent biological cultures and randomized batches
selection_policy: metadata/reference-only panel selection before combination outcomes; preserve a sealed confirmation block
